_description: Contract schema defining the required shape of future Rise FC standalone schema operator run ledger entries. This is a reference definition only — it does not create run entries, does not generate schema, and does not authorize any production action.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this governed schema run. Must be unique within the ledger. Never reuse a runId.

prNumber.description: The PR number that authorized or documented this run. Ties the run entry to the package PR history.

targetUrl.description: The confirmed target page URL for this schema run.

pageFamily.description: The page family for this run. Homepage is the first target.

mode.description: The operating mode for this run. Mode 1 targets the current risefcsoccer.com website. Mode 2 targets the future Astro implementation.

schemaProfile.description: The confirmed schema profile name used for this run. Must match an approved profile in 07_REFERENCE_LISTS/.

truthFingerprint.description: SHA-256 truth fingerprint confirmed at run start. Must match the fingerprint in RISE_HOMEPAGE_TRUTH_FINGERPRINT_LOCK_V1_0.md for homepage runs.

runDate.description: Date the governed schema run was performed.

readinessStatus.description: Result of Prompt 08 page content readiness gate. Must be READINESS_GATE_PASSED before drafting proceeds.

evidenceMapStatus.description: Status of the evidence map for this run. Must be EVIDENCE_MAP_CONFIRMED before a draft is produced.

draftStatus.description: Status of the non-production JSON-LD draft for this run.

qaStatus.description: Result of Claude external QA (Prompt 02) and independent analyzer review (Prompt 13) for this run.

controllerStatus.description: Result of controller decision (Prompt 03 and Prompt 14) for this run.

validationStatus.description: Result of the full 9-step validation protocol (FINAL_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1_0.md) for this run.

implementationStatus.description: Status of the current website implementation handoff for this run. IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF_DELIVERED requires human approval record.

astroCarryStatus.description: Status of Astro schema carry for this run. ASTRO_CARRY_NOT_APPLICABLE is the expected value for all Mode 1 runs until Astro carry gates are defined.

productionLockStatus.description: Production lock status for this run. PRODUCTION_LOCKED requires explicit human approval record and may never be self-claimed by any automated process.

humanApprovalRef.description: Reference to the human approval record. Required if implementationStatus is IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF_DELIVERED or productionLockStatus is PRODUCTION_LOCKED.

outputBundleRef.description: Reference to the output bundle directory or manifest file for this run.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for this run entry.

schemaVersion.description: Reference to the run ledger schema version used to validate this ledger.

entries.description: Array of run ledger entries. Each entry must conform to runLedgerEntryShape.
